en.attemptTimeoutHint: One attempt is cut off after this long and the queue moves to the next provider or key. 1000–60000.
en.description: Serves web search through a prioritized queue of AnySearch / TinyFish / Tavily / Brave / Exa / Firecrawl / Jina / SerpApi / Serper.
en.duplicateKind: This provider is already queued; each provider can appear once.
en.entryEnabledHint: A disabled entry stays configured but is skipped.
en.queueHint: A web search tries the entries top-down: the first one that returns wins, a failed entry falls through to the next. Keys within one provider rotate and fall through the same way. Each provider can be queued once.
en.saveFailed: Saving failed; the edits are kept.
